say:1:1622320001:0.text: Guh... I'm so tired! Chased shadows all night, didn't catch a single fin, and now I smell like a whole pack of monsters!
say:1:1622320001:0.source_cn: ​咕……累死本咕了！跑了一晚上，鱼影子都没捞着，还惹了...

say:2:1622320002:0.text: That starglider totally tricked me... Its glow is weaker than the fireflies in the bushes...
say:2:1622320002:0.source_cn: 幻灵星游那家伙原来真是骗我的……它的影响范围还不如草丛...

choice_prompt:3:1622320002.text: That starglider totally tricked me... Its glow is weaker than the fireflies in the bushes...
choice_prompt:3:1622320002.source_cn: 幻灵星游那家伙原来真是骗我的……它的影响范围还不如草丛里的萤火虫姐姐大呢……

say:4:1622320003:0.text: Wait, wait, I've got a plan! Let's just grab a crab. Or a frog. Anything that lives in water. We'll deliver it to that dummy Pracel and call it a day!
say:4:1622320003:0.source_cn: 等等，本咕有个主意！咱们随便捞只螃蟹、青蛙……只要是水...

choice_prompt:5:1622320003.text: Wait, wait, I've got a plan! Let's just grab a crab. Or a frog. Anything that lives in water. We'll deliver it to that dummy Pracel and call it a day!

say:6:1622320004:0.text: Cheating? No! This is called strategic task delivery. Very different!
say:6:1622320004:0.source_cn: 怎么能叫作假呢！这叫……战略性任务交付！​

say:7:1622320005:0.text: If we tell him we came up empty, that blockhead's gonna hound me day and night until we actually find that starglider...
say:7:1622320005:0.source_cn: 要是老实告诉他没找到，以他的死脑筋，肯定得缠着本咕打听...

say:8:1622320006:0.text: Worse, he might make it a daily routine! I'll never sleep again! My dark circles will be bigger than my eyes!
say:8:1622320006:0.source_cn: 说不定还是长期骚扰！每天都得跟他出来蹲点！那本咕还睡不...

say:9:1622320007:0.text: Come on, help me out here... I just want some rest... If this keeps up, I'll be a fried featherball by next week...
say:9:1622320007:0.source_cn: 帮帮忙嘛，我想好好休息……再这样下去，本咕都要折腾成废...

say:11:1622320008:0.text: Guh! Thank you, biped! You're the best!
say:11:1622320008:0.source_cn: 咕！谢啦，两脚兽，有你真好！

say:12:1622320009:0.source_cn: 以后有信件要送，尽管来找我！本咕保证比传送术还快！
